title: Spikers' Turf: Alpha Insurance makes quick work of VNS-Laticrete, boosts semis push
summary: Alpha Insurance swept VNS-Laticrete, 25-22, 25-16, 25-14, to bolster its semifinal push in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil Centre.
